title: Mike and strings
statementMd:
Mike has $*n*$ strings $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*n*}$ each consisting of lowercase English letters. In one move he can choose a string $*s*_{*i*}$, erase the first character and append it to the end of the string. For example, if he has the string "`coolmike`", in one move he can transform it into the string "`oolmikec`".

Now Mike asks himself: what is minimal number of moves that he needs to do in order to make all the strings equal?

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$) — the number of strings.

This is followed by $*n*$ lines which contain a string each. The $*i*$-th line corresponding to string $*s*_{*i*}$. Lengths of strings are equal. Lengths of each string is positive and don't exceed $50$.

## Output

Print the minimal number of moves Mike needs in order to make all the strings equal or print $- 1$ if there is no solution.

## Note

In the first sample testcase the optimal scenario is to perform operations in such a way as to transform all strings into "`zwoxz`".
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Mike 有 $*n*$ 个字符串 $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*n*}$，每个字符串都只由小写英文字母组成。在一次操作中，他可以选择一个字符串 $*s*_{*i*}$，删除其第一个字符，并将该字符追加到字符串末尾。例如，如果他有字符串 `coolmike`，那么一次操作可以将其变为 `oolmikec`。

现在 Mike 想知道：为了使所有字符串都相等，他至少需要进行多少次操作？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$），表示字符串的数量。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含一个字符串。第 $*i*$ 行对应字符串 $*s*_{*i*}$。所有字符串的长度相等。每个字符串的长度为正数，且不超过 $50$。

## 输出格式

输出 Mike 为使所有字符串相等所需的最少操作次数；如果无解，则输出 $- 1$。

## 说明

在第一个样例测试中，最优方案是通过操作将所有字符串变为 `zwoxz`。
